verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.110
11. Clouds
Vipers
“Mendicants, there are these four kinds of viper.
What four?
One whose venom is fast-acting but not lethal,
one whose venom is lethal but not fast-acting,
one whose venom is both fast-acting and lethal, and
one whose venom is neither fast-acting nor lethal.
These are the four kinds of viper.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, these four individuals similar to vipers are found in the world.
What four?
One whose venom is fast-acting but not lethal,
one whose venom is lethal but not fast-acting,
one whose venom is both fast-acting and lethal, and
one whose venom is neither fast-acting nor lethal.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso?
verses.english: And how is an individual’s venom fast-acting but not lethal?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: but their anger doesn’t linger long.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso.
verses.english: That’s how an individual’s venom is fast-acting but not lethal.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso āgataviso, na ghoraviso;
verses.english: That individual is like a viper whose venom is fast-acting but not lethal.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo ghoraviso hoti, na āgataviso?
verses.english: And how is an individual’s venom lethal but not fast-acting?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na heva kho abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is not often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: but their anger lingers for a long time.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo ghoraviso hoti, na āgataviso.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso ghoraviso, na āgataviso;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso ca hoti ghoraviso ca?
verses.english: And how is an individual’s venom both fast-acting and lethal?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: and their anger lingers for a long time.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo āgataviso ca hoti ghoraviso ca.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nevāgataviso hoti na ghoraviso?
verses.english: And how is an individual’s venom neither fast-acting nor lethal?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na heva kho abhiṇhaṁ kujjhati.
verses.english: It’s when an individual is not often angry,

verses.pali: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṁ anuseti.
verses.english: and their anger doesn’t linger long.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nevāgataviso hoti, na ghoraviso.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, āsīviso nevāgataviso na ghoraviso;
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These four individuals similar to vipers are found in the world.”
